one_liner: Steward is a company context layer for every AI: through MCP it watches what matters in each person's own AI conversations, rules on what becomes the team's shared truth (sources weighted by role and domain, contradictions clarified then escalated), serves each person the right context for their role and task, and keeps the team coordinated (progress, alerts, meetings).

zetaris.role: governance data over 3 sources (Postgres org chart and trust, finance REST API, catalogue as a REST table on the public repository) and a Unified Semantic Layer

meterless_engines.role: the company memory: versioned decisions (supersedes), provenance, trust-weighted confidence, CEO policies

nvidia.role: Nemotron pinned by exact id on the three lanes (nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b, nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b), served model logged per call

cursor.role: development environment and one of the MCP clients in the demo

domains.admin: personal admin desk (second pack on the same harness)
